description: Wever Watch: register a standing instruction for the paying wallet. Give a target (a public HTTPS JSON data endpoint, a prediction market as kalshi:<ticker> or polymarket:<id or slug>, or a Base wallet address with USDC or ETH), a condition (field, operator above, below, at_or_above or at_or_below, and a threshold), a callback_url and an expires_at up to 30 days ahead. The server checks on its scheduler every check_interval_seconds (default 300). When the condition is met it POSTs a signed fire report to callback_url and stores the fire record. It re-arms after the condition clears and completes after max_fires (default 1). Version 1 sends reports and moves no money. POST /api/watch-create. One call covers every check until the watch ends. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Every call carries X-Wever-Wallet-Proof bound to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route; a paid call adds Payment-Signature from the same wallet. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/watch-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/watch/.

callback_url.description: Public HTTPS URL that receives the signed fire report as a JSON POST.

field.description: data_endpoint: JSON pointer or dot path to a number, for example /data/price or data.price. prediction_market: yes_price, yes_bid, yes_ask or last_price (default yes_price). base_wallet: balance.

threshold.description: Number or decimal string. Wallet balances use whole asset units, for example "25.5".

max_fires.description: Fire reports before the watch completes. Default 1.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL that returns JSON. Read with GET, no redirects, up to 256 KB.

market.description: kalshi:<market ticker>, polymarket:<numeric market id> or polymarket:<market slug>.

asset.description: Native Base USDC or ETH balance.
